data.description:
## Context

`AGENTS.md` §"Navigating the codebase (when editing rebar itself)" describes the Serena
MCP server as operating over "this checkout". That is no longer accurate on the operator's
host: Serena has been re-pointed at a dedicated, filesystem-read-only clone that tracks
`origin/main` and is refreshed by a `StartInterval=3600` LaunchAgent (the same shape as the
existing `com.navapbc.rebar-dev-update` agent).

Two consequences follow that an agent reading `AGENTS.md` cannot infer, and that silently
produce wrong conclusions:

1. Serena's view is a snapshot of `origin/main`, refreshed on a poll interval, so it can
   trail current `main` by up to that interval.
2. It therefore never contains uncommitted work sitting in the worktree the agent is
   actually editing.

An agent that assumes Serena indexes its own worktree will read a stale or absent symbol
and conclude the code does not exist.

## Approach

Append ONE short paragraph to the existing §"Navigating the codebase" section of
`AGENTS.md`, immediately after the closing "Cross-cutting change → do **both**…" paragraph.
It states only (a) Serena reads a read-only mirror of `origin/main` rather than the local
checkout, and (b) that mirror auto-updates on a lag, so its answers can trail `main` and
will not show uncommitted worktree work.

Prose only, in the surrounding voice and bold-emphasis style. No table row is added; the
existing table is about Serena-vs-grep failure modes, which this is not.

## Scope

IN scope: the mirror fact and the staleness expectation, in `AGENTS.md` only.

OUT of scope, deliberately, and must NOT appear in the change:
- any warning about Serena's edit tools or write hazards
- worktree isolation guidance
- how the mirror or its LaunchAgent is built, located, or operated (machine-local, and
  `CLAUDE.local.md` / `docs/*.local.md` are git-ignored — this repo change carries no
  host-specific paths)
- edits to `docs/code-navigation.md` or any other file

## Portability

Documentation-only prose in a checked-in guidance file. It adds no code path, no command,
no CI trigger, and no dependency on any CI provider, scheduler, or host service. The
guidance is written host-agnostically ("a read-only mirror of `origin/main`", "a poll
interval") so it is equally true for any environment that points Serena at a mirror, and
harmless where Serena is absent — that case is already covered by the section's existing
`claude mcp get serena` pointer. Nothing in it can fail to trigger, because nothing in it
triggers.

## Acceptance criteria

1. `AGENTS.md` §"Navigating the codebase (when editing rebar itself)" contains a paragraph
   stating that Serena reads a read-only mirror of `origin/main` rather than the local
   checkout.
   Verify: `grep -n 'read-only mirror' AGENTS.md` prints a line inside that section.
2. The same paragraph states that the mirror refreshes on a lag, so Serena's answers can
   trail current `main` and do not include uncommitted worktree work.
   Verify: `grep -nE 'trail|uncommitted' AGENTS.md` prints lines in that paragraph.
3. No other file in the repository is modified.
   Verify: `git diff --name-only origin/main` prints exactly `AGENTS.md`.
4. The addition is confined to the named section and does not restate or contradict the
   existing Serena/grep division-of-labour table.
   Verify: `git diff origin/main -- AGENTS.md` shows only added lines, all between the
   section's "Cross-cutting change" paragraph and the `## Git workflow` heading.
5. Out-of-scope topics are absent: the addition mentions neither Serena's edit tools, nor
   write/edit hazards, nor worktree isolation, nor any host-specific path or LaunchAgent.
   Verify: `git diff origin/main -- AGENTS.md | grep -iE 'replace_symbol|insert_after|edit tool|write|launchagent|/Users/'` prints nothing.

## Definition of done

- [ ] `AGENTS.md` edited as above; acceptance criteria 1-5 all verified.
- [ ] `make lint` passes.
- [ ] `make typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `pytest tests/unit/test_module_size_contract.py` passes (CI-only gate; `make lint`
      does not run it).
- [ ] `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check` passes.
- [ ] Change pushed to `refs/for/main`, carries `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`, no
      unresolved comments, and is submitted/merged.

## File impact

- `AGENTS.md` — append one paragraph to the "Navigating the codebase" section.
data.title: Document that Serena reads a read-only origin/main mirror
